2.192.25
NumericIndicator.SeparatorColor
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The NumericIndicator.SeparatorColor element is ignored if it is present. However, its data type is
validated, and the value MUST be an RdlColor or an expression that evaluates to an RdlColor.
The following is the parent element of the NumericIndicator.SeparatorColor element.
Parent elements
NumericIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the NumericIndicator.SeparatorColor element.
 <xsd:element name="SeparatorColor" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
